scientific_question: Family-local proposer competence at fixed Korean token exposure under one frozen tokenizer, corpus stream, objective, and optimization family.

primary_analysis.final_partial_batch_policy: Allowed; final step consumes only remaining tokens and is loss-normalized by realized non-pad tokens.
primary_analysis.data_stream: One canonical token stream shared identically by S0-S3.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Capacity effect at fixed 100M-token exposure; not an optimal-scaling or universal compute frontier.

objective.document_boundary: EOS between documents; no cross-document semantic label

optimizer.schedule: linear warmup then cosine decay to 10% of peak LR

initialization.std_rule: 0.02 base; output/residual projection scaling may follow the frozen implementation but must be identical in rule across S0-S3

precision.prohibition: Precision choice may change numerical execution but not token stream, optimizer hyperparameters, or architecture.

data_roles.tokenizer_only: reconstructed and hard-excluded by exact record hash
data_roles.dev: 2M canonical tokenizer tokens, document-disjoint from train/tokenizer-only

model_selection.dev_role: training-health diagnostic only; no hyperparameter retuning after outcomes

engineering_smoke_tests.rule: May test pipeline correctness but cannot choose hyperparameters, rank models, or count toward PIA.

secondary_analysis.future_rule: Any compute-matched or scaling-law lane requires a new prospective seal before observing its outcomes.

prohibited: Increase token budget only for a PIA-failing checkpoint and retain confirmatory authority.
Retune learning rate or warmup from dev loss after training begins.
Use external LLM generations as hidden targets.
Use PIA labels or human revision actions in model training.
Treat fixed-token capacity threshold as a universal parameter threshold.
